# design port ball primitive setting

idelay_sweep p8 H5 IDELAYE2 SIGNAL_PATTERN=CLOCK
idelay_sweep p9 H4 IDELAYE2 IS_IDATAIN_INVERTED=1
idelay_sweep p10 F2 IDELAYE2 CINVCTRL_SEL=TRUE,pin:CINVCTRL=c1
idelay_sweep p11 E1 IDELAYE2 IDELAY_TYPE=VARIABLE,pin:C=gclk,pin:CE=c0,pin:INC=c1

idelay_sweep p15 D3 IDELAYE2 IDELAY_TYPE=VAR_LOAD,pin:C=gclk,pin:CE=c0,pin:CNTVALUEIN={c3, c2, c1, c0, c3},pin:INC=c1,pin:LD=c2
idelay_sweep p16 E2 IDELAYE2 IDELAY_TYPE=VAR_LOAD,IDELAY_VALUE=9,pin:C=gclk,pin:CE=c0,pin:CNTVALUEIN={c3, c2, c1, c0, c3},pin:INC=c1,pin:LD=c2
idelay_sweep p17 D1 IDELAYE2 IDELAY_TYPE=VAR_LOAD_PIPE,pin:C=gclk,pin:CE=c0,pin:CNTVALUEIN={c3, c2, c1, c0, c3},pin:INC=c1,pin:LD=c2,pin:LDPIPEEN=c3,pin:REGRST=c0
idelay_sweep p18 C1 IDELAYE2 IDELAY_TYPE=VAR_LOAD_PIPE,PIPE_SEL=TRUE,pin:C=gclk,pin:CE=c0,pin:CNTVALUEIN={c3, c2, c1, c0, c3},pin:INC=c1,pin:LD=c2,pin:LDPIPEEN=c3,pin:REGRST=c0
idelay_sweep p19 B1 IDELAYE2 IDELAY_TYPE=VAR_LOAD,PIPE_SEL=TRUE,pin:C=gclk,pin:CE=c0,pin:CNTVALUEIN={c3, c2, c1, c0, c3},pin:INC=c1,pin:LD=c2
